00180 void ScopeView::paint(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00181 {
00182     CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00183     CGContextClearRect(context, rect);
00184     
00185     CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[Background].getFloatArray());
00186     CGContextFillRect(context, rect);
00187     CGContextStrokePath(context);
00188     
00189     //testText();
00190         
00191     int width = getWidth();
00192     if(width != previousWidth)
00193     {
00194         lock();
00195         resizedGUI();
00196         unlock();
00197         
00198         previousWidth = width;
00199     }
00200     else
00201         calculateBuffers();
00202     
00203     lock();
00204     
00205     if(minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00206     {       
00207         if(isBipolar)
00208             paintBipolar(rect);
00209         else
00210             paintUnipolar(rect);
00211     }
00212     
00213     unlock();
00214 }

00216 void ScopeView::paintBipolar(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00217 {
00218     CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00219     
00220     CGContextSetLineWidth(context, 1.0f);
00221         
00222     const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00223     
00224     if(numChannels > 0)
00225     {
00226         const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00227         const int channelHeight = getHeight() / numChannels;
00228         const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00229         
00230         const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00231         
00232         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00233         {
00234             const float top = channelHeight * channel - 0.5f;
00235             const float middle = top + halfChannelHeight;
00236             const float bottom = top + channelHeight;
00237             
00238             // top line
00239             if(channel > 0)
00240             {
00241                 CGContextBeginPath(context);
00242                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, top + 1.f);
00243                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, getWidth()-1, top + 1.f);
00244                 CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[TopLine].getFloatArray());
00245                 CGContextStrokePath(context);
00246             }
00247             
00248             float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00249             float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00250                     
00251             // first scope line
00252             CGContextBeginPath(context);
00253             CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[Trace].getFloatArray());
00254             
00255             CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5f, middle - oldMaximum);
00256             CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, 0.5f, middle - oldMinimum);
00257             
00258             oldMinimum += 1.f;
00259             oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00260             
00261             for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++)
00262             {               
00263                 float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00264                 float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00265                 
00266                 float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00267                 float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00268                 
00269                 if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00270                 {
00271                     if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00272                     {
00273                         lineTop = 0.f;
00274                         lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00275                     }
00276                     else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00277                     {
00278                         lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00279                         lineBottom = 0.f;
00280                     }
00281                 }
00282                 
00283                 lineTop = middle - lineTop;
00284                 lineBottom = middle - lineBottom;
00285                 
00286                 // the scope lines
00287                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, i + 0.5f, lineTop);
00288                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, i + 0.5f, lineBottom);
00289                 
00290                 oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00291                 oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00292             }
00293             
00294             CGContextStrokePath(context);
00295             
00296             paintXScale(rect, middle);
00297             paintYScale(rect, middle, top);
00298             paintYScale(rect, middle, bottom);
00299             paintChannelLabel(rect, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, top);
00300         }       
00301     }
00302 }

00395 static inline void floatToString(char* string, const int size, const float value, const int decimalPlaces)
00396 {
00397     snprintf(string, size, "%.*f", decimalPlaces, value);
00398 }

00400 static inline void timeToTimecodeString (char* string, const int size, const double seconds)
00401 {
00402     const double absSecs = fabs (seconds);
00403     const char* const sign = (seconds < 0) ? "-" : "";
00404     
00405     const int hours = (int) (absSecs / (60.0 * 60.0));
00406     const int mins  = ((int) (absSecs / 60.0)) % 60;
00407     const int secs  = ((int) absSecs) % 60;
00408     const int ms =  ((int)(absSecs * 1000 + 0.5)) % 1000;
00409     
00410     if(hours == 0)
00411     {
00412         if(mins == 0)
00413         {
00414             snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d.%03d", sign, secs, ms);
00415         }
00416         else
00417         {
00418             snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d:%02d.%03d", sign, mins, secs, ms);
00419         }
00420     }
00421     else
00422     {
00423         snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d:%02d:%02d.%03d", sign, hours, mins, secs, ms);
00424     }
00425 }

00427 static inline void frequencyToString (char* string, const int size, const double frequency)
00428 {
00429     if(frequency >= 1000.0)
00430     {
00431         snprintf(string, size, "%.2fkHz", frequency * 0.001);
00432     }
00433     else
00434     {
00435         snprintf(string, size, "%dHz", (int)(frequency + 0.5));
00436     }
00437 }

00439 void ScopeView::paintXScale(CGRect const& rect, const int y) throw()
00440 {
00441     CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00442     
00443     // zero line
00444     CGContextBeginPath(context);
00445     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00446     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, getWidth()-1, y + 0.5);
00447     CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[ZeroLine].getFloatArray());
00448     CGContextStrokePath(context);
00449     
00450     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00451     {       
00452         const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00453         const double samplesPerPixel = (double)getWidth() / audioBufferSize;
00454         
00455         const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
00456         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
00457         
00458         unsigned int mark = 0;
00459         const int labelOffsetX = 3;
00460         const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
00461         
00462         CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeX, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00463         CGContextSetRGBFillColor (context, 0, 1, 0, 1);
00464         CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, flipTransform);
00465         
00466         CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextX].getFloatArray());
00467         CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[LabelMarks].getFloatArray());
00468         
00469         CGContextBeginPath(context);
00470         for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
00471         {           
00472             const int x = audioIndex * samplesPerPixel + 0.5;
00473             
00474             if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
00475             {
00476                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00477                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y - markXHeight * 1.5 + 0.5);
00478                 
00479                 if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00480                    (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
00481                 ) {
00482                     char label;
00483                     if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00484                     {
00485                         timeToTimecodeString(label, sizeof(label), 
00486                                              (audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00487                     }
00488                     else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00489                     {
00490                         double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00491                         double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00492                         
00493                         frequencyToString(label, sizeof(label), binFreq);
00494                     }
00495                     else
00496                     {
00497                         snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%d", (int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
00498                     }
00499                     
00500                     CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 
00501                                              x + labelOffsetX + 0.5f, 
00502                                              y - labelOffsetY + 0.5f, 
00503                                              label, strlen(label)); 
00504                 }
00505             }
00506             else
00507             {
00508                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00509                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y - markXHeight + 0.5);
00510             }
00511             
00512             mark++;
00513         }   
00514         CGContextStrokePath(context);
00515     }
00516 }

00518 void ScopeView::paintYScale(CGRect const& rect, const int zero, const int maximum) throw()
00519 {
00520     if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYNone)
00521     {
00522         CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00523         
00524         const double markSpacing = markSpacingY;
00525         const int decimalPlaces = decimalPlacesY;
00526         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopY;
00527         
00528         unsigned int mark = 0;
00529         const int labelOffsetX = markYWidth * 1.5 + 2;
00530         const int labelOffsetY = textSizeY / 2 + 2;
00531         
00532         const int height = zero-maximum;
00533         const double pixelFactor = (double)height / yMaximum;
00534         
00535         const double sign = height > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00536         
00537         CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeY, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00538         CGContextSetRGBFillColor (context, 0, 1, 0, 1);
00539         CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, flipTransform);
00540 
00541         CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextY].getFloatArray());
00542         CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[LabelMarks].getFloatArray());
00543         
00544         CGContextBeginPath(context);
00545         for(double level = 0.0; level <= yMaximum; level += markSpacing)
00546         {
00547             const int y = zero - level * pixelFactor;
00548 
00549             if((((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)) && 
00550                (mark > 0) && 
00551                ((level+markSpacing) <= yMaximum))
00552             ) {
00553                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00554                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, markYWidth * 1.5 + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00555                 
00556                 if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYMarks)
00557                 {
00558                     char label;
00559                     floatToString(label, sizeof(label), sign * level, decimalPlaces);
00560                     CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, labelOffsetX + 0.5f, y + labelOffsetY + 0.5f, label, strlen(label));  
00561                 }
00562             }
00563             else
00564             {
00565                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00566                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, markYWidth + 0.5, y + 0.5);    
00567             }
00568             
00569             mark++;
00570         }
00571         CGContextStrokePath(context);
00572     }
00573 }

00575 void ScopeView::paintChannelLabel(CGRect const& rect, Text const& label, const int index, const int top) throw()
00576 {
00577     if(labelChannels)
00578     {
00579         CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00580         
00581         const int size = 256;
00582         char labelToPaint;
00583         
00584         if(label.length() == 0)
00585         {
00586             snprintf(labelToPaint, size, "Ch%d", index + channelLabelOffset);
00587         }
00588         else
00589         {
00590             snprintf(labelToPaint, size, (const char*)label, index + channelLabelOffset);
00591         }
00592         
00593         CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeChannel, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00594         CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, flipTransform);
00595         CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextChannel].getFloatArray());
00596                 
00597         // measure the text
00598         CGContextSetTextDrawingMode(context, kCGTextInvisible);
00599         CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 0, 0, labelToPaint, strlen(labelToPaint));
00600         CGPoint pt = CGContextGetTextPosition(context);
00601         CGContextSetTextDrawingMode(context, kCGTextFill);
00602         
00603         // draw it right aligned
00604         CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 
00605                                  getWidth() - pt.x - 3 + 0.5f,
00606                                  top + textSizeChannel + 2 + 0.5f, 
00607                                  labelToPaint, strlen(labelToPaint));   
00608     }
